method: Manual review of every canonical record. Every correction cites the manufacturer page it was verified against (sources); CPU power and integrated-graphics fields cite the manufacturer spec page for each CPU. "valid" means no defect was found in this review; it is not a live retailer check and does not change any part's specsVerified flag.

validity.corrected: A defect was found and repaired in this audit, verified against the cited sources.
validity.needs-review: Ambiguous variant; ineligible for recommendations until an exact SKU is recorded.
validity.invalid: Not a real purchasable product as described; ineligible, kept for identity and benchmark references.

lifecycle.legacy: Two or more generations old. A label only: it does not by itself make a part ineligible.

recommendation.eligible: May appear in recommendations. Older parts stay eligible and are labelled.
recommendation.ineligible: Never recommended, for a recorded concrete reason (invalid, needs-review or unsuitable) - never age alone.
